accessibility.focus: Inherited blue 3px outline / 4px offset; bento uses orange 3px / 4px, branches orange 2px / 3px.
accessibility.motion: Optional engines disabled for reduced motion, Calm, high contrast, forced colors, hidden document and inactive views. Fine hover pointers gate bento tilt/spotlight. disableAnimations recreates and resets the bento engine.
accessibility.transparency: GlassLayer becomes opaque for reduced transparency, high contrast or forced colors. Touch/reduced motion keeps frosted glass without SVG refraction.
accessibility.contrast: Final glass-theme.css overrides muted and line colors; atmosphere hidden for reduced transparency/high contrast; forced colors restores system surfaces/borders.
accessibility.navigation: Single labeled rail/dock tree, native project/branch links, collapsed branches aria-hidden and inert; native modal focus/scroll behavior preserved.
accessibility.preferences: V2-specific System/Light/Dark, Calm and Atmosphere persistence.

extensions.rampProvenance: Tonal ramps are synthesized OKLCH panel previews from each source color's hue and chroma, with stepped lightness. They are not implemented CSS tokens or new usage rules; translucent source colors are previewed without alpha.
extensions.snippetScope: Self-contained source-derived visual specimens. Glass/bento shows the implemented frosted fallback; Tech Text shows the implemented DOM fallback; expanded branch markup shows actual visual geometry. Real refraction, Canvas interactions, bento engine, and folding/state handlers run in the app. No vendor sample content is presented as portfolio content.

glassSurface.refraction: Fine hover pointer and no reduced-motion request; decorative inert layer behind content.

techText.fallback: DOM h1 when effects disabled; hidden accessible name when canvas enabled; capped device pixel ratio 2 and offscreen pausing.

magicBento.content: Actual featured manifest projects and a project-index anchor.

branchedMenu.selection: Controlled from route parameters; native anchors and SVG chevron; collapsed content inert.

extensions.breakpointBehavior: Base floating rail 208px / workspace 244px; <=1150 rail 183px / workspace 216px; <=800 rail 68px / workspace 90px; <=600 floating dock and 14px main gutters. Bento measures its container using 150px minimum cells and 200px pair cells.

components.name: Tech name fallback
components.description: The actual DOM name shown with effects disabled. Interactive Canvas 2D Tech Text is documented in renderer settings and runs only in the app.

narrative.overview:
Ice-blue or deep navy ground, refractive glass, blue light, orange actions, and orbital geometry give practical information work a vivid interactive setting. Geist and consistent line icons keep the material system legible. This user-pinned world applies only to `v2/` and supersedes its earlier notebook direction.

The four requested React components define the experience: Tech Text makes the name respond to pointers and taps; Magic Bento presents actual selected projects with light and tilt; Branched Menu unfolds native-link shortcuts; Glass Surface renders refraction behind content. The atmosphere drifts when effects are enabled. Calm mode, system accessibility preferences, touch capabilities, active-view state, and page visibility govern the effects.
keyCharacteristics: Ice-blue and navy themes with legible orange actions and blue illumination.
Floating glass panels, rounded geometry, soft depth, and orbital lines.
Interactive identity, content-backed bento, and folding branch shortcuts.
Native navigation and task controls with deliberate motion and transparency fallbacks.

rules.name: The Semantic Glass Rule
rules.body: Use live theme variables for glass, text, and supporting UI; retain the implemented fixed orange primary-action palette.

rules.name: The Text Above Refraction Rule
rules.body: Keep rendered text and controls outside the distortion layer; the glass filter belongs behind their content.

rules.name: The Opaque Escape Rule
rules.body: Preserve the implemented fallbacks so readability and operation remain available when refraction, transparency, or motion is suppressed.

dos: **Do** use ice-blue/navy glass with readable orange actions and blue illumination.
**Do** keep actual Glass Surface refraction behind text and controls.
**Do** use actual Tech Text, Magic Bento, and Branched Menu implementations for signature interactions.
**Do** retain native direct project links, visible navigation labels, and title-first index rows.
**Do** honor Calm, reduced motion, reduced transparency, high contrast, forced colors, and hidden-page behavior.
donts: **Don't** propagate the scoped V2 system into V1 or root design context.
**Don't** reintroduce the superseded notebook palette or its static-only atmosphere restriction.
**Don't** distort text or controls inside the refraction layer.
**Don't** replace real portfolio content with vendor demo tiles or decorative metrics.
**Don't** rely on optional effects to expose content, state, or navigation.
